fact: Obone AI, a Gabonese platform by ZAIA Technologie and the Comité scientifique gabonais de recherche sur l'IA to understand, translate and speak Fang in writing and voice, was presented on 7 October 2026 and announced as soon to be available, with data to be verified by speakers and linguists.
title: Obone AI : une intelligence artificielle gabonaise pour traduire et faire parler le fang
